channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: Age of Wonders: Planetfall
item.description: Age of Wonders: Planetfall is the new strategy game from Triumph Studios, creators of the critically acclaimed Age of Wonders series, bringing all the exciting tactical turn-based combat and in-depth empire building of its predecessors to space in an all-new, sci-fi setting.

item.title: Agefield High: Rock the School
item.description: Relive your High School days in the town of Agefield. It’s the early 2000s, and graduation is on the horizon. REBEL with your friends, win over your dream girl and ROCK the school! A coming-of-age adventure about friendship, love, and rebellion inspired by the raunchy teen comedies of the era.

item.title: AI2U: With You 'Til The End
item.description: Kidnapped by a cute yandere catgirl, your only way out is to persuade her to let you leave! Engage with thematic stories, solve puzzles, and interact with best yandere AI NPCs in this top-rated AI game loved by millions of fans. Bask in sweet meet-cutes, or brace for chaos if you dare to escape! :3

item.title: Cult of the Lamb: Heretic Pack
item.description: Show your devotion to the Old Faith with Cult of the Lamb: Heretic Pack. This cosmetic set includes new Follower forms, a set of dastardly decorations for your Cult, and Fleece of the Old Faith for the Lamb to wear.

item.title: Cult of the Lamb: Sinful Pack
item.description: Sin to your heart’s content with Cult of the Lamb: Sinful Pack. This pack is the perfect way to indulge for those who enjoy a gluttonous aesthetic befitting kings and queens. Vanity might be a sin, but there’s nothing wrong with that!

item.title: IGNOBLE
item.description: Destroy enemies and harvest blood, bones, and marrow to grow stronger, unlock forbidden skills, and wipe out the Ignoble tyrants who dare threaten your master.

item.title: KINGDOM HEARTS HD 2.8 Final Chapter Prologue
item.description: KINGDOM HEARTS HD 2.8 Final Chapter Prologue features 3 magical experiences, all leading up to KINGDOM HEARTS III.

item.title: Kingdom Rush 5: Alliance TD
item.description: While a formidable evil emerges, an unexpected alliance is taking shape! It will take the finest warriors of Linirea and the relentless Dark Army to stop it. Beware! Though they may journey side by side the ever-changing winds of fate could swiftly alter their course.

item.title: Mr. Sleepy Man
item.description: Mr. Sleepy Man is up way past his bedtime and out of control! Make a mess of everything you find and turn Bedtime Town against you! This sandbox adventure is filled with comical hijinks, outrageous characters, and platforming action!

item.title: The Cave Diver
item.description: A brutally challenging physics-horror caving game. Using only your hands, drag yourself down a suffocating cave system where every hold pulls you further into the darkness. Equal parts rage-game, claustrophobic nightmare, and descent into a forgotten folktale...

item.title: The One Fish
item.description: An online co-op game for 1-6 players where you fish with your friends to feed The One Fish! Catch fish of all shapes, sizes, and whimsical effects to keep up with its ever-growing appetite.

item.title: Ultimate Fishing® Simulator - Amazon River DLC
item.description: Have you ever dreamed of hunting river monsters? There are plenty of them in the Amazon! This beautiful, mysterious and dangerous river is inhabited by many species of predatory fish, which are considered one of the most dangerous in the world!

item.title: Ultimate Fishing® Simulator - Florida DLC
item.description: Unleash your inner angler in Ultimate Fishing Simulator: Florida DLC! Sail to Dry Tortugas, snag Black sea bass, Tarpon, and more on your own boat. Adventure awaits!

item.title: Ultimate Fishing® Simulator - Japan DLC
item.description: In the land of cherry blossoms, 9 new species of fish are waiting for you. You will be able to catch both colourful Koi Carp and huge monsters that would easily drag you under the water. Welcome to Japan!

item.title: Ultimate Fishing® Simulator - Moraine Lake DLC
item.description: Famous glacial lake in Canada. The lake contains numerous species of Trout and Zander. Of course, those are not the only species found here. Maybe you should find out for yourself about the secrets that are hiding in this lake?

item.title: Security 51
item.description: You're a security officer deep within Area 51. Scan the staff, verify clearances, and decide who can enter the elevator and who absolutely mustn't leave. The deeper you go, the less certain you are that anyone standing before you is still human.

item.title: Steel Division 2
item.description: Steel Division 2 is a historically-accurate WW2 real-time strategy game set on the Eastern Front. Features 1:1-scale turn-based army management and real-time tactical battles with thousands of men at your order.

item.title: Survival Log
item.description: The apocalypse is here, and you saw it coming. Survival Log is a zombie-apocalypse hoarding survival sim. Hoard supplies, reinforce your home, and optimize every run before zombies flood the city. Every failure becomes experience. You must adapt and survive this time.

item.title: Weed Supermarket Simulator
item.description: Weed Supermarket Simulator is a chill store sim where you grow weed, develop new strains, set prices, and keep your shelves stocked. Expand your business and optimize it for maximum profit. Manage employees, handle inventory, and turn your shop into a high-performing business.

item.title: Hariti
item.description: "Hariti" is a first-person psychological horror game. You will play as a mother searching for her missing daughter in a crisis-ridden hospital. Experience an atmosphere of extreme dread within the halls of this abandoned Chinese-style medical facility.

item.title: Mandate Order
item.description: Mandate Order is a Warring States war city-builder set in ancient China. Build a stronghold, manage industries and logistics, recruit scholars from the Hundred Schools of Thought, raise armies, and command real-time tactical battles with thousands of soldiers.

item.title: A Space for the Unbound
item.description: A magical adventure about two high school sweethearts set at the end of their school days - and the end of the world. Explore a crumbling town and help friends face their inner demons, which could be the key to stopping reality itself disintegrating. And don’t forget to pet the cats.

item.title: Assassin's Creed® III Remastered
item.description: Relive the American Revolution or experience it for the first time in Assassin's Creed® III Remastered, with enhanced graphics and improved gameplay mechanics. Also includes Assassin's Creed Liberation remastered and all solo DLC content.

item.title: No More Room in Hell 2 - Veteran Survivor Pack
item.description: As the living dead walk the earth your ultimate mission is SURVIVAL!

item.title: Raging Loop
item.description: The feast has begun, can you escape the village alive?

item.title: Agent 64: Spies Never Die
item.description: A retro spy FPS inspired by the N64 era. Go guns-blazing in action-packed shootouts, steal secret plans, and accomplish objectives while foiling evildoers’ schemes as a secret agent in a solo or co-op campaign. Fight friends in both local split-screen multiplayer and online with up to 8 opponents.

item.title: Black Myth: Wukong
item.description: Black Myth: Wukong is an action RPG rooted in Chinese mythology. You shall set out as the Destined One to venture into the challenges and marvels ahead, to uncover the obscured truth beneath the veil of a glorious legend from the past.

item.title: Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® III
item.description: In the direct sequel to the record-breaking Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® II, Captain Price and Task Force 141 face off against the ultimate threat.

item.title: Crime Simulator - Ashen Creek DLC
item.description: Explore a brand-new neighborhood map with over 9 new spots to break into and loot. Steal new cars, avoid traps like pressure floors, and hit places like jewelry stores or pharmacies. Ashen Creek could be your biggest payday yet.

item.title: Demonologist
item.description: Demonologist is a Co-Op horror game that can be played with at least 1 and up to 4 players. Your goal is to identify the type of evil spirit in cursed places and exorcise it using your equipment, either alone or with your team.

item.title: Exotica 2: Pet Shop Simulator
item.description: Exotica 2: Pet Shop Simulator is a cozy management game where you design and run your own exotic pet shop. Care for over 70 animals, raise babies, breed rare color variants, customize your store, and manage customers and staff.

item.title: Landscaper Simulator
item.description: Lawns are wild. Parks are buried in weeds. Streets are littered. The world needs a hero, and that’s where you come in. As the Landscaper, it’s your job to turn disorder into beauty. With your weed whacker, pressure washer, and trash vacuum, you’ll trim, wash, and restore every space to perfection.

item.title: Luminary
item.description: "Very Positive" Demo, Luminary is a solo or co-op OpenZone Action RPG that creates a balanced experience for everyone. Using a unique world and character progression system, explore vast hand-crafted lands together, uncover hidden treasures, level up your town, and push back the darkness with light.

item.title: Mages of Mystralia
item.description: In a world of magic, your mind is your greatest weapon. Learn the ways of magic and design your own spells to fight enemies, navigate treacherous terrain, and right past wrongs in the kingdom of Mystralia.

item.title: RIFTSTORM
item.description: RIFTSTORM is a co-op PvE looter-shooter where squads of Weavers deploy to take on missions, fight escalating hordes, collect powerful weapons and resources, and extract.

item.title: Royalty Free-For-All
item.description: This hilarious party brawler features iconic characters, stages, and music reimagined for a modern generation—and simplifies combat, including an all new PARTY MODE, perfect for friends new to the genre

item.title: Shelves and Sorcery: Tidy Up the Enchanted Shop
item.description: Restore order to three ransacked fantasy shops! Organize thousands of items, master helpful sorceries and enchantments, relax at your own pace, race the global leaderboards, and unlock new ways to play. Every item has a shelf. Can you find them all?

item.title: Stonewards
item.description: DWARF COMBAT! Stonewards is a 1-4 player co-op first-person roguelite defense game. Lead a crew of stubborn dwarves from your base camp to aid nearby kingdoms, mine deep for resources, forge powerful upgrades, and hold the line against relentless monster attacks.

item.title: Swordcery
item.description: A colossal blade has pierced the world of Armorial, unleashing a storm of enchanted swords from the heavens. Collect and wield an arsenal of these spellbound blades, turning them against the very force that summoned them. In this roguelike ARPG, you will defy the Celestial evil consuming the world!

item.title: The Lord of the Rings: War in the North™ - Legacy Edition
item.description: Step into a darker, grittier Middle-earth. The Lord of the Rings: War in the North™ - Legacy Edition expands Tolkien’s epic legendarium, delving into the brutal, untold story of Agandaûr, a Black Númenórean and servant of Sauron who has rallied an immense force in the ruins of Fornost.

item.title: Ultimate Fishing Simulator®
item.description: Bored of waiting for a bite? Would you like to catch some fish? You're lucky - in Ultimate Fishing Simulator, fish bite like crazy! Spinning, float fishing, ground fishing, and more! Comprehensive fishing simulator that allows using various techniques, in different places around the world!

item.title: Warhounds
item.description: Warhounds is a turn-based tactics game about an elite mercenary squad with an old-school action movie vibe, inspired by XCOM and Jagged Alliance. Recruit unique fighters, upgrade your base, and fight for Africa’s future. No fake RNG - only true ballistics and lethal tactics.
